children: Tenet Healthcare announced an upsized $2.0 billion private offering of 6.250% senior notes due 2034 to refinance $1.5 billion of 2027 notes and partially redeem 2028 notes.
Priced and upsized private offering to $2.0B of senior notes due Sept 15, 2034 at 6.250% interest.
Proceeds, with cash on hand, will redeem $1.5B of 5.125% first‑lien 2027 notes and partially redeem $0.5B of 6.125% 2028 notes.
Closing expected Sept 22, 2026, with redemptions of the 2027 and 2028 notes expected on Sept 23, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
New notes are unsecured, pari passu with other senior unsecured debt, subordinated to secured obligations and structurally subordinated to subsidiaries.
